skills.name: Werewolf Berserker
skills.description:
Transform into a berserk beast, fearing nearby enemies for |cffffff3|r seconds.

While transformed, you gain Major Berserk and your Light Attacks and Heavy Attacks apply a bleed for |cffffff4492|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff4|r seconds, or |cffffff2246|r Bleed Damage after |cffffff1|r second against players.

While transformed and in combat, abilities generate Fury. When you have |cffffff1000|r, this ability becomes Rampage, which increases your damage done, Movement Speed, and removes the cost of Werewolf abilities for |cffffff20|r seconds.

While slotted, your Stamina Recovery is increased by |cffffff15|r%.
